title: Mathematical and numerical admissibility qualification of P0 uniform-storage-tendency SCAFP
scientific_question: Does the prospectively selected P0 uniform-storage-tendency closure define a unique, conservative and numerically well-conditioned algebraic layer/column map over a broad synthetic B14 state domain before any hydrological response is tested?

assumptions: theta(psi) is strictly decreasing in positive suction psi.
The trial trajectory remains inside the declared constitutive domain.
layer_local_uniqueness_proof: For fixed psi_top and q_top, q_bottom is the scalar shooting variable.
The sensitivity y=dpsi/dq_bottom solves y'=a(z)y + xi/K(psi), y(0)=0.
The forcing xi/K is nonnegative and positive for z>0; the variation-of-constants solution gives y(z)>0 for z>0 regardless of the sign of a(z).
Since theta'(psi)<0, d/dq_bottom integral theta(psi(z)) dz = integral theta'(psi)y dz < 0.
Therefore the layer storage residual is strictly decreasing in q_bottom and has at most one admissible root.
not_claimed: Global existence for every possible layer storage.
bottom_up_symmetric_argument: For fixed psi_bottom and q_bottom, integrate upward and treat q_top as the local scalar shooting variable.
In upward coordinate s, dpsi/ds=1-q(s)/K(psi), and the sensitivity to q_top has strictly negative forcing.
Hence dpsi/dq_top<0 and, because theta'(psi)<0, the reconstructed storage is strictly increasing in q_top wherever the trajectory remains admissible.
The bottom-up local storage root is therefore also unique conditional on existence.

synthetic_domain.top_flux_rule: K evaluated at the storage-equivalent suction of the top retained layer; no fitted multiplier.

numerical_contract.layer_root: bisection on the first and only admissible sign-changing interval

outer_bottom_flux_scan.residual: reconstructed surface q_top minus prescribed surface flux

numerical_contract.outer_root: bisection on the single admissible q_bottom interval only if exactly one outer residual sign change exists

local_face_flux_scan.scalar: q_top for a layer given psi_bottom, q_bottom and target storage
local_face_flux_scan.purpose: G2 standalone local-existence stress test across the frozen synthetic Cartesian state box.

numerical_contract.bracket_verification: Every coarse sign-changing interval must retain opposite signs when re-evaluated on the 256-substep primary integrator before bisection qualification.

column_local_root_bracket.justification: G1 analytical strict monotonicity makes a dense local scan redundant inside nested column shooting.

qualification_gates.G1_ANALYTIC_LOCAL_UNIQUENESS: Proof conditions and sign argument encoded and independently checked against constitutive derivatives.
qualification_gates.G2_LOCAL_EXISTENCE: Every synthetic local case has exactly one admissible q_bottom root inside the frozen scan.
qualification_gates.G3_COLUMN_EXISTENCE_UNIQUENESS: Every synthetic column/boundary case has exactly one admissible outer root inside the frozen scan.
qualification_gates.G4_CONSERVATION: Layer flux differences equal the implied uniform storage tendency exactly by construction and column interface fluxes are shared.
qualification_gates.G5_STORAGE_CONSISTENCY: Each solved layer reconstructs its target storage within 1e-10 cm.
qualification_gates.G6_REFINEMENT_STABILITY: 256/512-substep solutions satisfy the frozen face-head/face-flux stability limits.
qualification_gates.G7_NO_RESPONSE_DATA: No C5R/C5T/C5N/C5P hydrological trajectory is consumed by the qualifier.

decision_logic.C5W_P0_LOCAL_MAP_ONLY_QUALIFIED_COLUMN_B: G1/G2/G4/G5 pass but G3 or G6 fails.
decision_logic.next_if_qualified: Prospectively preregister a frozen-state P0 interface-flux discriminator before any free-running reduced model.
decision_logic.next_if_blocked: Stop P0 route; do not tune scan bounds, profile family or numerical branch from failed cases.

stop_rules: No hydrological response trajectory may be read or generated in C5W.
No bracket-range, quadrature/substep or tolerance retuning after qualification response.
No scalar correction or fitted parameter.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: Synthetic B14 constitutive/map qualification only; no hydrological trajectory, free-running closure, response fit or dynamic state.
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: Hydrological response execution, C5R/C5T residual consumption, bracket retuning after result, production closure implementation.
